Practical note: Aave states liquidations are permissionless: if health factor is insufficient, “any address” can initiate liquidation and receive repaid debt + bonus.
Silo docs say collateral-sale liquidations are “always permissionless and economically incentivized”; terms also say any third party may perform liquidations.
A bot/individual can call `absorb`; profit usually comes from later `buyCollateral` at a discount when reserves are below target.
Fluid describes liquidations as discounted trades: “any trader” can sell debt back to the vault for discounted collateral.

Treat as money-market/leverage surfaces to verify per current contract: look for public `liquidate`/`absorb` and check fees/rakes, e.g. Dolomite documents Arbitrum liquidation penalties and a March-2026 liquidation-fee rake.
